tasks.description: One entry per task in the brief, every task ID exactly once.

verdict.description: met: the diff fully does what the card asks and every check passes. not_met: something the card asks is missing or wrong. brief_incomplete: the brief lacks this task's card or done_when, or hides a file the diff touches.

missing.description: not_met only: what the card asks that the diff lacks, one item each.

finding_ids.description: IDs of submitted findings that bear on this task.

checks.description: Each command you ran with run, with its exit code. The harness reruns any check a verdict depends on.

summary.description: Internal: your reasoning, for a re-review. No person or builder reads it.
